verdict.summary: Round 2's blocking policy issue is resolved: the research record no longer transcribes work-box byte counts, timings, percentages, exact ratios, noise estimates, or capacity observations as measured results. It retains reproducible commands, qualitative directional findings, and an explicit non-canonical caveat. The feature remains default-off, the default dense path is pinned, the feature-on sparsify and decline branches are exercised, and the cross-arm test compares every dictionary ID against a freshly recomputed dense reference while guarding against a vacuous all-inline corpus. The sparse conversion and lookup paths preserve ID-to-value semantics, and the CI feature-matrix leg covers the opt-in state. Remaining numeric constants describe representation sizes, heuristic thresholds, or benchmark inputs rather than committed benchmark results.
